The amending words are "hereby amended by deleting the first sentence in Sec. 1-105." (preceded in the held text by 'Executive Order No. 12140 is'). First end: EO 12553 (signed 1986-02-25): "it is hereby ordered that the following Executive Orders, and" and "any amendments thereto, are revoked:" followed by a two-column 'No. Subject' table; the entry at offset 26770 of the held EO_12553.txt reads "12162", which matches this order's number and subject. EO 12553 has no effective-date wording, so the revocation is read as effective on signing, 1986-02-25. The Office of the Federal Register catalog note reads "Revoked by: EO 12553, February 25, 1986". The held EO 12553 text prints this part of the table (PDF page 14) as a number-only column followed by a separate subject column: the number 12162 is the 21st entry of the column and pairs by position with the 21st subject, "Continuing the delegation of authorities relating to motor gasoline end-user allocation" (offset 28535), consistent with this order's subject; the parent order EO 12140 is also listed in the table (its subject precedes at the 18th position).
